ComfyUIPromptOrder.description: Arrange existing tags using dictionaries and category order. Preserve spelling, weights, and duplicates.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Prompt tags to arrange. Accepts a connected STRING as well as direct input.

preset.name: Preset
preset.tooltip: Order used when category_order is empty. Custom uses Illustrious as its base.

category_order.name: Category order
category_order.tooltip: Leave empty for the preset order. Enter comma-separated categories; omitted categories follow in preset order.

pin_front.name: Pin to front
pin_front.tooltip: Move existing tags to the front in the specified order. Separate entries with commas.

pin_back.name: Pin to back
pin_back.tooltip: Move existing tags to the back in the specified order. A tag pinned at both ends is an error.

user_dictionary.name: User dictionary
user_dictionary.tooltip: JSON with version=1 and tags. Overrides built-in classifications. Empty input and {} are valid.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.tooltip: When disabled, return the input unchanged, including whitespace and line breaks.

0.name: Ordered prompt
0.tooltip: The prompt after ordering, or the unchanged input when ordering is disabled or the syntax is unsupported.
